news.title: A Mile Wide, an Inch Deep: The State of Civic Learning in U.S. School Districts
news.summary_en: This brief is the first in a three-part series from the American School District Panel, a research partnership between RAND and CRPE that surveys hundreds of school district leaders.

news.title: Pooling Europe's compute: The promise of distributed training for European frontier AI
news.summary_en: Frontier AI training has needed compute at one site, hard in Europe given power, chip and political limits. RAND Europe finds distributed training eases the power and political constraints and pools Europe's scattered chips, but adds no new chips.

news.title: Strategic Autonomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
news.summary_en: This essay argues that the rapid advance of AI will frustrate ambitions for strategic autonomy.

news.title: AI as Strategist: Four Hypotheses on the Nature of Agentic Strategy
news.summary_en: In this chapter, the author considers a radical future, a world in which nations pursue relative advantage, for national security, and for other national objectives guided by AI models that are mostly playing these strategy games against other models.
